sentences.text: The gold loan FAQ evidence provided states what a gold loan is, how much can be borrowed, and the tenure, but it does not give any pre-payment percentage for gold loans.
The only pre-payment percentages in the evidence are 2% and 3% in home-loan documents, and 2% in MSE business-loan sanction letters, which are not gold-loan FAQ terms.

missing.searched: Gold Loan FAQ sections on charges/pre-payment, and the provided UCB pre-payment rules for applicability to a gold loan
